_source: LCBT-Course-Match-Screen-Content.docx (1 Sept 2026). All user-facing strings live here.

steps.text: Get matched with your ideal course
Get the details sent straight to you

vibe.headline: What would you be excited to learn?
vibe.sub: Swipe right if you're into it, left if you're not
vibe.resultBody: Just the essentials left, then we'll calculate your matches properly.
vibe.fallbackSub: No worries, just tap what excites you most, or learn about all of our courses.

results.headline: Your matches are in
results.sub: Swipe right to save, left to skip
results.emptyBody: That's okay, we'll send you your original best match so you don't miss it.
results.successBody: You saved {n} course{s}. Let's get your personalised recommendations sent over.

email.headline: Almost there
email.sub: Pop your email in and we'll send your personalised course recommendations, so you can explore them properly whenever suits you.
email.smallPrint: We'll use your email to send the course matches you asked for. Marketing is opt-in and you can unsubscribe at any time.
email.errorInvalid: That doesn't look like a valid email address.
email.errorSend: Something went wrong sending your matches. Please try again.
email.consentLabel: Email me about open days, new courses and offers at LCBT.
email.smallPrintRegister: We'll only use your email to let you know when something suitable opens up. Marketing is opt-in and you can unsubscribe at any time.

confirmation.headline: Check your inbox!
confirmation.sub: Your matches are on their way. Here's one to screenshot in the meantime.
confirmation.shareText: I found my dream course at LCBT. Why don't you find your dream course too?

registerInterest.headline: You're on the list
registerInterest.sub: We'll email you the moment something suitable opens up. In the meantime, here's everything we run right now.

goalClause.career: A great foundation if you're ready to start working in the industry.
goalClause.self: This route builds exactly the skills most self-employed therapists start with.
goalClause.improve: A solid way to build on what you already know.
goalClause.change: Plenty of career-changers start exactly here.
goalClause.unsure: No pressure, this keeps your options open while you figure it out.

reasoningGoal.career: you want to start a career
reasoningGoal.self: you want to start your own business
reasoningGoal.improve: you want to build on your skills
